## Claim amendment · file surface

Measured by the card thread on main `4c318214`: `test:mcp` exits 1 at step 3 as the card says; mounting plugin-auth's `createIdentityObjectsPlugin()` (the documented reduced-kernel recipe, which creates the Default Organization before AppPlugin seeds) makes all 7 steps pass with no platform change. Route chosen: **wire**. `packages/mcp/src/mcp-action-confirmation-member.test.ts` names this script as the only place the confirmation gate's two halves run together against a real engine, so it has no duplicate. The script becomes `examples/app-todo/test/mcp-actions.test.ts` (vitest, in the example's own suite) and `test:mcp` goes.

The claim's file surface (above) gains two paths, both direct fallout of the wire:
- `pnpm-lock.yaml`: the new workspace devDependency `@objectstack/plugin-auth` on the example. Lockfile only; a conflict with another in-flight PR is settled by a main merge and re-resolve, never by hand-editing.
- `packages/mcp/src/mcp-action-confirmation-member.test.ts`: the one comment line that names the old `.e2e.ts` path, re-pointed. Comment only; the "no platform package change" bound still holds for code.

`packages/qa/dogfood/**` stays unused under this route. Everything else in the claim stands.
